text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Arrrgh! I was so close! So close!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
But... it was still a good race. I accept my
defeat!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
...All right! I'm gonna go home and train
my guts
out! First up, dragging a tire
around for a hundred
laps!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
...I concede that I wasn't strong enough
to win
today.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
However, I won't lose next time. Not as
an
individual or at the Unity Cup.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Until we meet again. And...
congratulations on
your victory.
